title: ITU Radio Regulations frequency coordination
body: Spacecraft radio emissions shall comply with the frequency allocations in ITU Radio Regulations Article 5. Coordination with affected administrations is required for any geostationary or non-GSO transmission. Out-of-band emissions shall meet RR Appendix 3 limits.
citation: ITU Radio Regulations 2020 edition, Articles 5 and 21

title: Geostationary station-keeping accuracy
body: Geostationary spacecraft shall maintain station-keeping within ±0.1 deg longitude and ±0.05 deg latitude under normal operation. Deviations require notification to Notifying Administration. End-of-life parking orbit shall be ≥ 235 km above the GEO ring.
